description: Complete wiring of snow_connector.py into approval_workflow daemon. Must wire inbound ServiceNow webhook to create mcp_submissions records. Must use write_service :8772 for all DB writes. Must implement numbered constraints: (1) MUST validate ServiceNow HMAC signature on all incoming webhooks, (2) MUST reject unsigned requests with HTTP 401, (3) MUST parse SNOW ticket fields into mcp_submissions schema (mcp_name, requested_by, notes), (4) MUST NOT make outbound HTTP to ServiceNow without explicit admin configuration. Reference: snow_connector_integration.py (already built).
